title: Portable Fitness Studio
subtitle: Fullstack Booking Platform
features: Interactive room and trainer reservation scheduling.
Real-time backend transaction recording in SQLite and Supabase.
Automated Excel-compatible CSV booking report exports for admins.
Integrated Razorpay checkout workflow for secure customer payment.
challenges: Data persistence & reporting: Configured structured schema synchronization with SQLite and automated CSV export pipelines.
Payment signature validation: Implemented cryptographic verification of Razorpay webhooks and order responses.
details: A fullstack fitness booking platform featuring a hybrid Node.js and Python backend, integrated with Supabase and SQLite databases for client details. Supports Razorpay payment gateway integration, automatic CSV exports, and dynamic scheduling.

title: Auto Spare Parts E-Commerce
subtitle: E-Commerce Frontend Website
features: Multi-page navigation (Home, Shop, Blog, Cart, and Product Details).
Clean, modern storefront styling using custom, vanilla CSS layouts.
Highly responsive visual grids tailored for mobile and desktop viewports.
Interactive client-side shopping cart drawer operations.
challenges: Optimizing layouts across dynamic screen sizes without framework assistance: Utilized pure CSS media queries, flexboxes, and custom aspect ratios.
Organizing multiple page templates: Structured layouts cleanly using standard semantic HTML5 tags and descriptive CSS selectors.
details: A multi-page responsive e-commerce web application displaying product details, a custom shopping cart, blog, and category listings. Styled cleanly with custom CSS and structured using semantic HTML5.

title: Object Detection System
subtitle: Computer Vision Web App
features: Real-time computer vision frame processing with OpenCV models.
Flask web server routing and serving interactive stream endpoints.
Fully containerized deployment setup using custom Docker configurations.
Production-ready runtime setup configured with Procfile and Gunicorn.
challenges: Streaming OpenCV video frames efficiently to browser endpoints: Constructed a Flask multipart MJPEG generator route, yielding consistent frame rates.
Ensuring identical dev and production runtime environments: Built a lightweight Dockerfile and configured dependencies in requirements.txt.
details: A computer vision application integrating a Flask web server and OpenCV object detection engine. Fully containerized using Docker and configured for deployment via Gunicorn and Procfiles.

title: AESTHETICA
subtitle: Interior Architecture Studio Website
features: Hero wordmark with the interior photography revealed through the letterforms.
Scroll-driven room story that furnishes an empty space step by step, with a numbered list of every room component.
Featured project, materials and four-step approach sections with a running materials ticker.
Project enquiry form and an editorial serif and sans layout in warm neutral tones.
challenges: Keeping a long scroll sequence smooth: Pinned and scrubbed scenes with GSAP ScrollTrigger so each stage plays forwards and reverses cleanly.
Large photography without slow loads: Sized and staged images per section so the page stays responsive while scrolling.
details: A website for a contemporary interior architecture and design studio. Built with React, Vite and Tailwind CSS, with GSAP ScrollTrigger animations that walk the visitor through a room from bare shell to finished space.

title: Essay Pressings
subtitle: Industrial Manufacturer Website
features: Searchable product catalogue with category filters and detailed spec views for washers, brackets and press parts.
Request-a-quote form that saves enquiries to Supabase.
Admin dashboard for reviewing incoming quote requests.
Light and dark themes, WhatsApp and call shortcuts, and a cookie consent notice.
challenges: Turning a large product range into something easy to browse: Built client-side search across name, description and material with category filtering.
Capturing leads reliably: Connected the quote form to a Supabase table so every enquiry is stored for the business to follow up.
details: A business website for a Chennai-based manufacturer of precision metal components, established in 2005. Built with React and TypeScript, it covers the company profile, products, infrastructure and industries served, with quote requests stored in Supabase.

title: Student Enrollment & Course Analytics Dashboard
subtitle: Power BI Dashboard
features: Ingested and modeled 200+ student enrollments using Power Query and custom DAX measures.
Built interactive dashboards with KPI gauges, donut charts, and dynamic demographic slicers.

title: Sales Performance Dashboard
subtitle: Excel Dashboard
features: Processed 100+ multi-region sales transactions to evaluate cost, revenue, and product profit margins.
Built an executive Excel dashboard using multi-dimensional Pivot Tables and interactive slicers.

title: Fitness Studio Database System
subtitle: Relational Database
features: Architected a 3NF relational schema in MySQL to manage fitness bookings and member records.
Authored optimized SQL queries using multi-table JOINs and aggregations to analyze utilization trends.
